title: Siren (SIREN) 📈 131.4%

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Siren's 131.4% surge is a bubble, not a breakthrough. No real-world adoption or revenue to back that valuation.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Siren's blockchain is interoperable and uses zero-knowledge proofs — real tech that’s solving major scalability issues.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Even with ZK proofs, Siren’s protocol lacks enterprise partnerships. No major DeFi or NFT platforms use it yet.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s changing. Siren just secured a partnership with Polygon to integrate its privacy layer — that’s real momentum.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This rally is justified — Siren’s tech is foundational for the next wave of decentralized apps.

caption_text: Siren is overvalued vs Siren rally is justified
